text: 你让脸色苍白的诺曼和西尔维娅把尸体抬到火边。你检查尸体，尤其仔细查看他的双脚。双脚几乎被暴露在外的环境摧毁：泛紫、流血，甚至像是被烧伤了？你无法理解，他怎么可能靠这样的脚走路。

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 97
text: You get an ashen-faced Norman and Sylvia to carry the body to the fire. You examine it, particularly the feet. They are almost destroyed by exposure: purple-tinged, bleeding, and—burnt? It is beyond you how he could have walked on them.
